nodes.rationale: HSV ink mask drops paper and pink grid; adaptive gaussian threshold handles shadows/creases; column-wise median Y with NaN interpolation; bottom 20% treated as Lead II rhythm strip; Y flipped so higher voltage plots upward.

nodes.label: Request path: finalizing a prescription
nodes.rationale: Safety checks and the record lock live in Postgres triggers, not in the app, so a request that skips the UI still hits them. The WhatsApp API route reads the recipient from the database, not the request body.

nodes.label: zz_audit_row trigger / append-only audit_logs
nodes.rationale: Writes old and new JSONB to audit_logs on 83 tables; log_phi_read() records reads inside RPCs.

nodes.label: We are not losing on features, we are losing on finishing
nodes.norm_label: we are not losing on features, we are losing on finishing
nodes.rationale: Eka lets a solo doctor run an OPD day in ~8 clicks with WhatsApp delivery; DocPad guarantees nothing unsafe reaches the DB but takes ~20 clicks and sends a link missing the diagnosis.

nodes.label: Two different bets: doctor-as-customer (Eka) vs institution/database-as-product (DocPad)
nodes.norm_label: two different bets: doctor-as-customer (eka) vs institution/database-as-product (docpad)
nodes.rationale: DocPad puts safety rules in the database where no screen can route around them; the cost is click count. The bets do not conflict: a hard stop that takes one keystroke is still a hard stop.

nodes.label: Clinical-safety advantage is architectural, not yet clinical
nodes.norm_label: clinical-safety advantage is architectural, not yet clinical
nodes.rationale: The only allergy entry screen writes patients.known_allergies, which patient_allergy_matches classifies as 'unknown'; unclassified substances never set the blocking flag.
